projects.title: V4 architecture
projects.description: Backend lead for the shift from a single-page app to a routed workspace-and-tab application, working with two full-stack engineers focused on the frontend. Product and design set the direction, including shared tables and multiple people editing the same records concurrently. I designed and built the backend that made it work: a server-authoritative sync model where mutations commit server-side, record an operation and emit a sync event that clients reconcile, making multiplayer collaboration and undo architectural properties rather than bolted-on features. I also built the core of the layer that routes every entity view through one shared set of services instead of bespoke code per view; the team extended it from there.
